column1: # The conformance map of nfl4 (S8.1, 2026-10-19; CLAUDE.md 3: "conformance tests vs spec"). Read by tests/test_conformance.py.
# One row per requirement: the id, then one or more entries, separated by tabs. An entry is  <test file>::<regex>  (the file without
# its test_ prefix and its .py; the regex is searched in the test function names of that file, so a plain piece of a name will do)
# or  NA: <reason>  (a requirement that has no behavior to test, with the reason).
# test_conformance.py checks that every requirement of the spec has a row, that no row names a requirement that is not in the spec,
# and that every entry matches at least one test function. spec/CONFORMANCE_MATRIX.md is made from this file by
# work/s81/matrix_s81.py (it adds the test names and the counts).
# Ids: S<n> and S<n.m> the sections of GAME_SPEC 1 to 14 (the leaf headings), Q1 to Q62 the quirks of section 15, X1 to X7 the seven
# bullets of 17.2 (what must stay exact), G-xx the gap-register entries that close in S8.1, OBS-foot<n> the 26 sounds the owner
# confirmed by ear (observations/), C1 to C10 the cross-cutting requirements and N1.1 to N7.7 the features' requirements of
